His trademark three-dot style wasn't even his own; he pilfered it from Walter Winchell . . . but, after he won a special Pulitzer Prize in April, the city he called "Baghdad-by-the-Bay" named a waterfront promenade after him. For ten points, who is this beloved San Francisco Chronicle columnist who died February 1?
